preconditions.description: Number of test cases t is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: for n, q in zip(n_list, q_list): 3 <= n <= 10**6 and 3 <= q <= n
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of cities n is between 3 and 1,000,000, and q is between 3 and n.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 for x in output_list)
postconditions.description: Each output value is a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of roads to demolish.

postconditions.expression: for i in range(t): output_list[i] == min_roads_to_demolish(n_list[i], q_list[i])
postconditions.description: Each output value correctly computes the minimum number of roads to demolish for the corresponding test case.
